recommendations.pros: Elite-level upper breathability and an exceptionally lightweight build. Provides an agile, forward-rolling rocker suitable for daily runs and tempos.
recommendations.cons: The narrow fit may pinch wider toes, and the ride can feel firm to some.

recommendations.pros: Very lightweight with a snappy, bouncy eTPU midsole ride. Offers versatile performance for daily road miles and tempo paces at an approachable price.
recommendations.cons: Narrow midfoot fit is not ideal for wider feet, and pure neutral geometry lacks inherent stability elements.

recommendations.pros: Exceptionally lightweight build with soft and energetic bounce. Reverse camber geometry aids smooth transitions for daily miles and uptempo work.
recommendations.cons: Lacks robust midfoot upper support, and heavier runners over 190-200 lbs may bottom out the foam.

recommendations.pros: Delivers an exceptionally lightweight and flexible ride powered by bouncy supercritical foam. Fantomfit upper locks down comfortably for daily miles and half-marathon pace work.
recommendations.cons: Toebox durability is relatively weak, and the foam may compress too quickly under heavier runners.

recommendations.pros: Dependable daily cruiser featuring a stable platform and outstanding outsole durability. Exceptionally soft and comfortable upper mesh built for daily wear.
recommendations.cons: Feels relatively heavy and lacks energetic forefoot rebound.

tips: For daily road training paired with half marathon prep, moderate-cushion trainers provide a sweet spot of impact protection without unnecessary bulk or mushiness.
Be mindful of differing heel-to-toe drops; lower-drop options like 5-6 mm engage the calves and Achilles more, while 8-10 mm designs shift workload toward the knees and hips.
